dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, jagged high-contrast perimeters forming complex 'O' and 'C' shapes. Edges show a sharp transition from dark-tone base pixels to thin, high-intensity white/silver borders, enclosing mid-tone interior regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, small high-intensity pixel clusters situated primarily in the mid-body lateral region, often acting as vertices or terminal points for the larger annular structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent annular structures form an elongated, obtuse scalene triangle spanning the mid-dorsal to posterior-lateral region.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive dendritic or filament-like high-contrast lines connecting several macro-annular structures across the central dorsal-lateral plane.
